figs: cf. Ma+ Sect. 4.3.2, gas-dominated case: L1 error of rho (top) and E (bottom) after one period vs the exact damped eigenmode, N = 16-256 cells per wavelength, nt = 2N steps per period (dt ~ dx), tau_lambda = 0.01 / 1 / 100. cf. Ma+ Sect. 4.3.2, radiation-dominated case: as above.
Extended grid: finest-pair order (N 128 -> 256) of rho and E for every (P_rad/P_gas, tau_lambda); green = second order.
Extended grid: L1 error vs N for each combination (rho circles, E triangles); dashed slope 2.
sections.text: Second order in rho in all six 1-D regimes; the 2-D diagonal wave E at P 3.3e-3, tau 1 is 1.31 (see the flags). Extended grid (10-21, production method, binary 4de8168d, x1, N 16-256, dt ~ dx): P_rad/P_gas 3.3e-3 - 3.33 x tau 0.01 - 1000. rho is second order except P 3.33 tau 10 (1.12). E LOSES ORDER IN THE THIN REGIME: finest-pair 0.66 / 0.66 / 0.76 at tau 0.01 and 1.55 / 1.58 at tau 0.1 (P <= 0.33); P 3.33 tau 10 E 1.37. P_rad/P_gas 33 is omitted: with c_light = 10 it has E/(rho c^2) = 1, outside the Newtonian regime of the test (the conservative2 write-back loop under time2_vstage diverges there).
